name: Janggi (Korean Chess) Pieces

movement.cannon: leap_over(orthogonal, exactly:1, if:not_cannon) | leap_over(palace_diagonal, exactly:1, if:in_palace AND not_cannon)

note: Standard Janggi set: 16 pieces per side (1 general, 2 advisors, 2 elephants, 2 chariots, 2 horses, 2 cannons, 5 soldiers). Played on a 9x10 grid at intersections. Octagonal pieces distinguish it from Xiangqi. Cho (red) and Han (blue) sides use different characters for generals, cannons, and soldiers. Elephants move differently from Xiangqi: one step orthogonal then two steps diagonal.
